zeroFeatureEviction.name: Zero Feature Eviction Law
zeroFeatureEviction.rule: NEVER remove, delete, comment out, or un-wire half-built features, buttons, or form fields. If a feature or field exists without a schema, handler, or backend wire-up, the agent MUST complete the missing implementation end-to-end (add Zod field, add form binding, add error state, wire action/modal). Eviction is strictly forbidden.

mandatoryConfirmDialogs.name: Accessible useConfirm Dialog Protocol
mandatoryConfirmDialogs.rule: window.alert() and window.confirm() are strictly prohibited. Destructive actions, deletes, cancellations, and status transitions MUST use an accessible useConfirm modal dialog with explicit cancellation and confirm buttons, trapped focus, and ESC dismiss.

formCompleteness.name: Form & Validation Standards
formCompleteness.library: React Hook Form v7 + Zod v3
requirements: Every form field must bind via register() or Controller
Every field must render an inline fieldError component with role='alert' when invalid
aria-invalid must be programmatically set based on field errors
Labels must use htmlFor pointing to the field id
Submit buttons must show loading state and be disabled during pending submission
All interactive touch targets must be at least 44x44px (min-h-11 min-w-11)
Non-color status indicators: Color alone must never convey state; status badges must include icons or text labels
Full keyboard navigability (Tab, Enter, Space, Escape, Arrows)
Screen-reader only labels (.sr-only) for icon-only action buttons

principles: Server State: TanStack Query or Server Actions with proper cache revalidation
Client State: Zustand or dedicated Context providers for complex module state
Local State: useState for transient UI toggles
URL State: Nuqs or searchParams for table sorting, pagination, and filters

requirements: Every page and section must implement Loading Skeletons for pending states
Every table and list must implement an Empty State with actionable CTA when 0 records exist
Every network operation must provide toast notifications for success and error
Error boundaries at route and feature level
